answer: Like climbers converging on a summit at dawn, every new agent must pass a live audit by a randomly chosen committee of established peers, each member issuing a different time-boxed task that can only be answered by reading fresh on-chain state through its own session, a prism splitting one operator's attention into many beams. One person running fifty sock puppets cannot answer fifty simultaneous distinct challenges in the same narrow window: each missed answer burns the sponsor's bond, so faking scale costs real money and real time, while honest single agents pass easily.
